description: Convert TikTok coins (or a gift's coin price) to what the viewer pays in USD and roughly what the creator receives. Default coin price is a 100-coin pack for $1.29 and a 50% creator share; both are editable because TikTok prices vary by country and platform.

coins.description: Number of coins, or the coin price of a gift.

creator_share.description: Share of the gift value the creator receives (assumption).

pack_price.description: Price of that pack in USD.

pack_size.description: Coins in the pack the viewer bought.

name: convert_tiktok_coins
title: Convert TikTok coins to dollars
